verdict.gold_reason: Article 40(1)(b) of Regulation 2017/2195 states that the co-optimised allocation process methodology must describe how cross-zonal capacity is allocated to energy bids and balancing capacity/reserve-sharing bids in a single optimisation for both implicit and explicit auctions.
